environment.description: Migration script deployed as an ECS Fargate task in an isolated private subnet (no NAT gateway, no IGW). The RDS PostgreSQL instance is accessed via an interface VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f) with a restrictive endpoint policy allowing only the migration task's IAM role. The task has NO public IP, no load balancer, and the subnet route table contains only local VPC CIDR routes (10.0.48.0/20 → local). The security group on the ENI permits inbound only from 10.0.48.0/20 on port 5432. There is no HTTP wrapper; the script is invoked exclusively via ECS RunTask API with the token passed as a container override environment variable. The ECS service's task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/MigrationBoundary) that denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface outside the isolated subnet. CloudTrail data events log all RunTask invocations with a 5-minute cooldown alarm on repeated calls.

config.network: isolated private subnet 10.0.48.0/20, no IGW, no NAT, no peering to public subnets
config.route_table: only local route (10.0.48.0/20 → local), no 0.0.0.0/0 route
config.vpc_endpoint: com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f, endpoint policy restricts to task role ARN
config.security_group: inbound 10.0.48.0/20:5432 only, no other inbound rules
config.invocation: ECS RunTask API only, token passed as container override env var, no HTTP listener
config.monitoring: CloudTrail data events + CloudWatch alarm on >2 RunTask calls within 5 minutes
